# BootstrapConfig { #qte.bootstrap.BootstrapConfig }

```python
bootstrap.BootstrapConfig()
```

Configuration for the bootstrap.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type         | Description                       | Default    |
|-----------|--------------|-----------------------------------|------------|
| n_iter    | [int](`int`) | Number of bootstrap replications. | _required_ |
| seed      | [int](`int`) |                                   | _required_ |
| n_workers | [int](`int`) | Number of worker threads.         | _required_ |
